_comment: Permissions Changed To Run Or Unlock A File. Generated from rules/chmod_then_execute.yml by tools/build.py; do not edit.

properties.displayName: Permissions Changed To Run Or Unlock A File
properties.description: A command makes a file executable (chmod +x or a numeric mode) and runs it in the same line, without a download in that line, or removes the immutable or append-only attribute with chattr -i / -a. The first is the last step of droppers that wrote their binary another way, such as hex-escaped echo chunks; the second unlocks files like ~/.ssh before the attacker overwrites them. Lines that also download are left to the download-and-execute rule, so one dropper command raises one alert.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Permissions Changed To Run Or Unlock A File from {{src_ip}}
